_doc: How the buildings are drawn (render/buildings/building_look.cpp): by style the instanced facade parts' sizes, the lot fence's bars and the roof plant; each finish seen from afar; the levels of detail. What the generator builds is data/catalog/buildings.json.

parts._doc: Sizes of the instanced facade part models (part_models.cpp): frame bar, door handle, brise fin (m). guard_h_m: the top of every guard (balcony, loggia and gourmet railings, roof terrace rails) above its floor, ABNT NBR 14718:2019 (guarda-corpos para edificacao: at least 1.10 m, raised from 1.00 m in the 2001 edition).

lot._doc: Lot fence and gate bar thickness (lot_emit.cpp), m.

roof._doc: Roof plant: square metres per air handler (roof_plant.cpp PLANT per_area).

finish_far._doc: Each finish from afar, linear, in the order of its layers: the mean of its map (project/assets/surfaces/building-finishes.map.png, measured texel by texel in linear), times 0.91, the mean of the weathering the near level draws, for all but metal and glass. The far level multiplies a wall's tint by it.

lod._doc: hull_error_m: how far the simplified hull that throws the mid level's shadow may stray from its walls, under a shadow texel at that distance. level_fade_m: the band over which the near level and its parts dissolve into what follows; level_back_m: how far along the eye's ray the mid level stands behind the near one there, more than a window's recess. Shares of render.building_detail_end_m: parts (frames, railings, AC units) and the full near shell; the mid level (painted windows, real roofs) runs to building_mid_end_m, the far masses beyond. part_bands: instanced facade parts by bar width (second largest side), each drawn until it covers px_min pixels; far_hysteresis: a chunk leaves its superchunk's far mesh for its own detail below building_mid_end_m from its centre (with the eye height) and goes back beyond building_mid_end_m x (1 + it) (a band either side of the switch, so a chunk does not flicker between levels). far_rebuild_delay_s / far_rebuild_interval_s: a superchunk that already has its far mesh is rebuilt at least that long after a change and after its previous rebuild (a building appearing kilometres away is a few pixels).
